recipes.title: Pan-Seared Rump Steak with Garlic Butter
recipes.summary: A weeknight steak from fridge to plate in fifteen minutes, finished with melting garlic butter.
ingredients: A sprig of rosemary or thyme
steps: Pat the steaks dry and season generously with salt 20 minutes before cooking.
Heat a heavy pan until almost smoking, add the oil and sear 2-3 minutes per side for medium.
In the last minute add butter, garlic and herbs and spoon the foaming butter over the meat.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.
recipes.tips: A dry surface is the secret of a brown crust. Never crowd the pan.

recipes.title: Classic Grilled Ribeye
recipes.summary: Well-marbled and forgiving on the grill: the cut that rewards you for doing almost nothing to it.
steps: Take the steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes before cooking.
Rub with oil and season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
Grill over hot coals, 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, moving off the flames if fat flares up.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice and serve.
recipes.tips: Use a thumb test: soft like the base of your thumb means rare, firmer means medium.

recipes.title: Kenyan Beef Stew (Mchuzi wa Nyama)
recipes.summary: Tender beef in a thick tomato and onion gravy, the everyday favourite served with ugali, rice or chapati.
steps: Boil the beef in salted water for 45 minutes until half tender, keeping the stock.
Fry the onions in oil until golden, then add garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook down to a thick paste.
Add the beef and a cup of the stock, simmer 30 minutes, adding carrots for the last 15.
Finish with coriander and adjust the salt.
recipes.tips: Cooking the tomatoes until the oil separates gives the gravy its depth.

recipes.title: Beef Wet-Fry
recipes.summary: Cubed beef boiled tender, then fried with onion and tomato into a saucy skillet dish.
steps: Boil the beef with salt until tender, about 40 minutes, and keep a cup of the stock.
Fry the onions, then garlic until soft.
Add the beef and brown for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, pepper and stock, simmer 8 minutes to a glossy sauce.
Top with coriander and serve with ugali or chapati.

recipes.title: Kenyan Beef Pilau
recipes.summary: Fragrant spiced rice cooked in beef stock with pilau masala, a coast favourite for celebrations.
ingredients: 1 kg beef with bones, cut small
steps: Boil the beef in salted water until tender, reserving the stock.
Fry the onions in oil in a heavy pot until deep brown.
Add garlic, ginger and pilau masala, then the beef and potatoes.
Add the rice and 6 cups of hot stock, bring to the boil and stir once.
Cover tightly on the lowest heat for 20 minutes until the rice is done; fluff and serve with kachumbari.
recipes.tips: Dark brown onions give pilau its colour. Do not stir once the lid goes on.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
recipes.summary: Strips of beef in a creamy mushroom and mustard sauce over rice or pasta.
ingredients: 500 g beef fillet or rump, in strips
steps: Sear the beef strips in a hot pan in batches, 1-2 minutes, and set aside.
Cook onion and mushrooms in butter until golden; add garlic and flour.
Stir in the stock and mustard until thickened.
Return the beef, add the cream and warm through without boiling.
Serve over rice, buttered noodles or mashed potato.

recipes.title: Beef Bourguignon
recipes.summary: Beef braised slowly in red wine with bacon, mushrooms and onions until the sauce turns silky.
ingredients: 1.2 kg beef chuck, in big cubes
150 g bacon or streaky pork, diced
steps: Brown the beef in batches and set aside; fry the bacon in the same pot.
Cook onions and carrots, stir in tomato paste, garlic and flour.
Add wine, stock, herbs and the beef, cover and cook in a 160 C oven or on very low heat for 2 hours.
Fry the mushrooms separately and add for the last 20 minutes.
Season and serve with mash or crusty bread.
recipes.tips: It tastes even better the next day.

recipes.title: Beef Rendang
recipes.summary: A dry-style curry of beef simmered in coconut milk and spices until it is dark, sticky and intense.
ingredients: 5 shallots or 2 onions, 4 garlic cloves, 3 cm ginger, 3 cm galangal or extra ginger, 4 dried chillies, 1 tbsp coriander seed, 1 tsp turmeric
steps: Blend the spice paste smooth.
Cook the paste in a wide pot until fragrant, then add the beef, coconut milk, lemongrass and leaves.
Simmer uncovered for 2 hours, stirring more often as it thickens.
When the oil separates, add tamarind, sugar and salt and fry the beef in the oil until dark brown.
Serve with rice.
recipes.tips: Patience gives the dark caramelised finish.

recipes.title: Korean Beef Bulgogi
recipes.summary: Thin beef slices marinated in soy, pear and sesame and seared hot.
ingredients: 600 g thinly sliced beef (rump or sirloin)
steps: Mix everything except the beef and onions into a marinade.
Coat the beef and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Sear in a very hot pan in small batches until caramelised.
Scatter with spring onions and sesame and serve with rice and lettuce leaves.
recipes.tips: Freeze the beef for 30 minutes first to slice it thin.

recipes.title: Carne Asada Tacos
recipes.summary: Citrus and chilli marinated beef charred over high heat, sliced and tucked into warm tortillas.
ingredients: 600 g skirt, flank or rump steak
Tortillas, chopped onion, coriander and lime to serve
steps: Marinate the steak in the juices, garlic, spices and oil for 30 minutes to 4 hours.
Grill over very hot coals 3-4 minutes per side.
Rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly against the grain.
Fill warm tortillas with the beef, onion, coriander and a squeeze of lime.
recipes.tips: Do not marinate longer than 4 hours; the acid makes the meat mushy.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Tender beef strips and bright broccoli in a glossy garlic and soy sauce.
ingredients: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour, 1/4 cup water
steps: Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp cornflour.
Stir-fry the beef in very hot oil for 2 minutes and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger and broccoli with a splash of water for 3 minutes.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce and toss until glossy.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooked Oxtail Stew
recipes.summary: Sticky, collagen-rich oxtail slowly braised with onions, tomatoes and spices until it falls off the bone.
ingredients: 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp allspice or mixed spice
steps: Season and brown the oxtail in oil in a heavy pot.
Fry onions and garlic, add tomato paste, spices and tomatoes.
Return the oxtail, add stock and thyme, cover and simmer very gently for 3 hours.
Add carrots for the last 40 minutes, skim the fat and serve with rice or ugali.
recipes.tips: Make it a day ahead so the fat sets and can be lifted off.

recipes.title: Beef Chilli Con Carne
recipes.summary: A thick, smoky pot of beef, beans and chilli for sharing.
ingredients: 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika
steps: Brown the mince in oil, then add onion, pepper and garlic.
Stir in the spices and tomato paste for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and 1 cup water, simmer 40 minutes.
Add the beans for the last 10 minutes and season. Serve with rice or tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Beef Brisket Pot Roast
recipes.summary: A big, tender brisket braised until you can pull it with a fork.
steps: Rub the brisket with salt, pepper and paprika and brown it all over.
Lay onions, carrots and garlic in a deep dish; stir stock and tomato paste in.
Set the brisket on top, cover tightly and cook at 150 C for 4 hours.
Rest 20 minutes, slice across the grain and spoon the juices over.
recipes.tips: Always slice brisket across the grain.

recipes.title: Goat Mchuzi (Mbuzi Stew)
recipes.summary: Goat simmered with onion, tomato and spices until tender and rich.
ingredients: 1.2 kg goat meat on the bone
steps: Season the goat with salt and boil in water for 1 hour until nearly tender; keep the stock.
Fry the onions until brown; add garlic, ginger and spices.
Add tomatoes and paste, cook until thick.
Add the goat and 2 cups stock; simmer 40 minutes.
Finish with coriander; serve with ugali.
recipes.tips: Goat needs slow, wet heat.

recipes.title: Goat Biryani
recipes.summary: Spiced goat layered with fragrant basmati rice and cooked sealed until aromatic.
ingredients: Saffron or turmeric in warm milk
steps: Marinate the goat in yoghurt, ginger-garlic paste, masala, turmeric, half the fried onions and salt for 2 hours.
Cook the goat in its marinade, covered, until 80 percent tender (about 1 hour).
Parboil the rice in salted water to 70 percent done and drain.
Layer rice over the goat with herbs, fried onions, saffron milk and ghee.
Seal the pot with foil and lid; cook on very low heat 25 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.tips: Sealing the pot (dum) is what makes the layers steam together.

recipes.title: Caribbean Curry Goat
recipes.summary: Marinated goat in a golden curry sauce with potatoes.
steps: Marinate the goat with half the curry powder, garlic, thyme, salt and onions overnight.
Toast the remaining curry powder in hot oil, then brown the goat.
Add water, cover and simmer for 1.5 hours.
Add the potatoes and cook until soft and the sauce is thick.

recipes.title: Supu ya Mbuzi (Goat Soup)
recipes.summary: A peppery, warming broth of goat ribs and bones, popular at nyama choma joints.
steps: Cover the goat with water, bring to the boil and skim the foam.
Add onion, garlic, ginger, pepper and turmeric; simmer 1.5 hours.
Add tomatoes for the last 20 minutes; season and finish with coriander and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.tips: A warm bowl is a classic with grilled meat.

recipes.title: Goat Birria
recipes.summary: Chilli-rich goat braised until tender, served with its own consomme.
ingredients: 4 dried chillies (guajillo or ancho) or 2 tbsp chilli powder
steps: Toast and soak the chillies, then blend with tomatoes, onion, garlic, vinegar and spices.
Coat the goat in this adobo and rest 2 hours.
Cook covered with 1 cup of water at 160 C for 3 hours.
Shred the meat and serve in tortillas with a cup of the consomme.

recipes.title: Slow-Roast Goat Leg with Garlic and Rosemary
recipes.summary: A whole leg roasted low and slow with garlic, lemon and herbs.
steps: Stud the leg with garlic and rosemary; rub with oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Place in a roasting dish with water or wine; cover tightly with foil.
Roast at 160 C for 3 hours, uncover for the last 30 minutes to brown.
Rest 20 minutes, then carve.

recipes.title: Rosemary Grilled Lamb Chops
recipes.summary: Lamb chops with garlic, lemon and rosemary, quick over the coals.
steps: Mix oil, garlic, rosemary, lemon and seasoning; coat the chops and marinate 15-60 minutes.
Grill on high heat 3-4 minutes per side.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Roast Leg of Lamb
recipes.summary: A classic Sunday roast with garlic and herbs.
steps: Cut small slits into the lamb and push in slivers of garlic and herbs.
Rub with oil, salt and pepper; rest at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Roast at 180 C for about 2 hours for medium, basting twice.
Rest 20 minutes; make gravy from the pan juices and stock.

recipes.title: Lamb Rogan Josh
recipes.summary: A Kashmiri-style lamb curry, deep red and gently spiced.
ingredients: 2 tbsp Kashmiri chilli powder or paprika
steps: Brown the lamb in oil and set aside.
Fry the onions until golden; add garlic, ginger and the ground spices.
Stir in yoghurt gradually, then tomatoes and the lamb.
Add a cup of water, cover and simmer 1 hour until tender.
Finish with garam masala; serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine with Apricots
recipes.summary: Lamb cooked with cinnamon, ginger and sweet dried apricots.
ingredients: 1 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric
steps: Brown the lamb in oil; add onions and garlic.
Add the spices and stock; cover and simmer 1.5 hours.
Add the apricots and honey and cook uncovered 20 minutes until thick.
Top with toasted almonds and coriander; serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Braised Lamb Shanks
recipes.summary: Meaty shanks braised in red wine and tomato until falling off the bone.
steps: Season and flour the shanks, then brown in oil.
Soften the onions, carrots and garlic; add tomato paste, wine and stock.
Return the shanks with herbs, cover and braise at 160 C for 2.5-3 hours.
Reduce the sauce and serve with mash.

recipes.title: Mutton Karahi
recipes.summary: Mutton pot-cooked with tomatoes, ginger and green chilli until tender.
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp black pepper
steps: Fry the mutton with ginger-garlic paste until it changes colour.
Add tomatoes, spices and a little water; cover and cook 1 hour until tender.
Cook uncovered until the oil separates, then garnish with coriander and ginger strips.

recipes.title: Whole Roast Chicken with Lemon and Herbs
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned, juicy chicken with lemon and garlic.
steps: Pat the chicken dry; rub with butter, salt and pepper, under the skin too.
Stuff with lemon halves, garlic and herbs; set on the onion.
Roast at 200 C for 20 minutes, then 180 C for 60 minutes until the juices run clear.
Rest 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Juicy Grilled Chicken Breast
recipes.summary: A simple brine and a hot grill keep lean chicken breast moist.
steps: Brine the chicken breasts for 30 minutes, then pat dry.
Coat in oil and spices.
Grill over medium-high heat 6-7 minutes per side until 74 C inside.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.
recipes.tips: Pound thick breasts to an even thickness.

recipes.title: Kenyan Chicken Stew (Kuku Wa Kupaka)
recipes.summary: Chicken fried then simmered in a tomato and onion sauce.
steps: Season the chicken and brown in hot oil; set aside.
Fry onions, garlic, ginger and curry powder.
Add tomatoes and cook to a thick sauce.
Return the chicken with a cup of water; simmer 30 minutes.
Add pepper and coriander and serve with ugali or rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Biryani
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken layered with saffron-scented basmati rice.
steps: Marinate the chicken in yoghurt, paste, masala, half the onions and salt for 1 hour.
Par-boil the rice with whole spices to 70 percent.
Layer chicken, then rice, herbs, onions and saffron milk in a pot.
Seal and cook on low heat 30 minutes; rest 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
recipes.summary: Smoky tandoori-style chicken in a velvety tomato and cream sauce.
ingredients: 1/2 cup yoghurt, 1 tbsp lemon, 1 tsp chilli, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, salt
2 tbsp butter, 1 onion, 4 tomatoes blended, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp kasuri methi (optional), 1/2 cup cream, 1 tsp sugar
steps: Marinate the chicken for at least 1 hour, then grill or pan-sear until charred.
Cook the onion in butter, add the tomato puree and spices; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream and sugar, add the chicken and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka
recipes.summary: Yoghurt and spice marinated chicken cubes grilled until charred at the edges.
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast or thigh, cubed
steps: Mix the marinade and coat the chicken; refrigerate 2 hours.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill over high heat, turning, for 12-15 minutes until charred and cooked.
Serve with lemon, onions and chutney.

recipes.title: Kuku Paka (Coconut Chicken)
recipes.summary: Grilled chicken in a creamy, turmeric-scented coconut sauce from the coast.
ingredients: 1 chicken in pieces, grilled or fried
1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander
steps: Season and grill or fry the chicken until browned.
Fry the onions, garlic, ginger and spices; add tomatoes.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook 15 minutes; finish with lemon and coriander. Serve with chapati or rice.

recipes.title: Peri-Peri Chicken
recipes.summary: Spatchcocked chicken in a fiery lemon and garlic chilli marinade.
steps: Blend the marinade ingredients and rub it all over the chicken; refrigerate 2 hours or overnight.
Grill over medium heat, skin-side down first, 20 minutes per side, with the lid closed if you have one.
Baste with extra sauce and rest 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken marinated in allspice, thyme and scotch bonnet and grilled until smoky.
steps: Blend everything except the chicken into a paste.
Marinate the chicken at least 4 hours or overnight.
Grill over medium heat, 15-20 minutes per side, until charred and cooked.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Chicken
recipes.summary: Buttermilk-brined and double-coated for an extra-crisp crust.
ingredients: 2 cups buttermilk (or milk with 2 tbsp lemon)
2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp pepper, 2 tsp salt
steps: Soak the chicken in buttermilk for at least 2 hours.
Mix the flour and spices; coat each piece, dip again in buttermilk, and coat once more.
Fry in oil at 170 C for 12-15 minutes per batch until golden and 74 C inside.
Drain on a rack, not paper.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
recipes.summary: Chicken braised in soy and vinegar with garlic and bay.
steps: Combine everything in a pot and marinate 30 minutes.
Bring to the boil, then simmer covered 25 minutes.
Uncover and reduce the sauce, browning the chicken if you like.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sticky Chicken Wings
recipes.summary: Crispy oven-baked wings tossed in a honey, soy and garlic glaze.
ingredients: 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp lemon, 2 garlic cloves, chilli flakes
steps: Dry the wings and toss with baking powder and salt.
Bake at 200 C for 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Simmer the glaze 3 minutes, toss the wings in it and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup (Supu ya Kuku)
recipes.summary: A simple, comforting broth with vegetables and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Simmer the chicken with onion, garlic, ginger and water for 30 minutes, skimming.
Add carrots, celery and potato and cook 15 minutes.
Season; finish with coriander and lemon.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Shoulder
recipes.summary: Pork shoulder rubbed with smoky spices and cooked until it shreds.
ingredients: 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cumin
steps: Rub the shoulder with the spice mix and rest overnight if you can.
Place in a deep tray with the apple juice, cover tightly and cook at 140 C for 5-6 hours until it shreds.
Shred with two forks and mix with the cooking juices and barbecue sauce.
Pile into buns with coleslaw.
recipes.tips: The meat is done when a fork twists with no resistance.

recipes.title: Crispy Roast Pork Belly
recipes.summary: Soft, juicy meat with a blistered, crackling top.
steps: Dry the skin thoroughly (leave uncovered in the fridge overnight if possible).
Rub the salt and fennel into the scored skin and oil lightly.
Roast at 160 C for 2 hours, then raise to 230 C for 20-25 minutes until the skin blisters.
Rest 15 minutes and slice with a heavy knife.
recipes.tips: A dry skin is the secret of crackling.

recipes.title: Kenyan Pork Fry (Nguruwe Choma Fry)
recipes.summary: Pork boiled until tender and deep-fried or pan-fried until crisp on the edges.
ingredients: 1 kg pork belly or shoulder, cubed
steps: Boil the pork with onion, garlic and salt until just tender, about 30 minutes, and drain well.
Dry the pieces and fry in a little hot oil until deep golden and crisp.
Serve hot with kachumbari and ugali.
recipes.tips: Let the pork dry before frying so it crisps.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Pork
recipes.summary: Crisp pork pieces in a bright pineapple and pepper sauce.
ingredients: 4 tbsp ketchup, 3 tbsp vinegar, 3 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1/2 cup water, 1 tsp cornflour
steps: Coat the pork in egg and cornflour and fry until golden; drain.
Stir-fry the vegetables briefly.
Add the sauce mixture and cook until glossy.
Toss in the pork and pineapple and serve at once.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Apple
recipes.summary: Juicy chops with caramelised apple slices.
ingredients: A splash of cider or apple juice
steps: Season the chops and sear in a hot pan 4-5 minutes per side until golden.
Set aside; cook apple slices in the butter and thyme until soft.
Deglaze with cider, pour over the chops and rest 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Slow-Grilled Sticky Ribs
recipes.summary: Pork ribs slowly cooked then glazed with a sticky barbecue sauce.
ingredients: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper
1/2 cup barbecue sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce
steps: Season the ribs and wrap tightly in foil.
Cook at 150 C for 2 hours until tender.
Brush with glaze and finish over the coals or under the grill 10 minutes, turning and brushing.
Rest 5 minutes and cut between the bones.

recipes.title: Samaki wa Nazi (Fish in Coconut)
recipes.summary: Fish pieces simmered in a mild coconut and tomato sauce, a coastal favourite.
steps: Season the fish with salt and lemon and fry briefly on both sides.
Soften onion and garlic; add spices and tomatoes.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the fish and cook gently 8-10 minutes; finish with coriander.

recipes.title: Whole Grilled Tilapia, Kenyan Style
recipes.summary: Whole tilapia scored, seasoned and grilled until the skin crisps.
steps: Score the fish on both sides and rub with the garlic, lemon, salt, pepper and oil.
Grill over medium coals 8-10 minutes per side.
Serve with kachumbari and ugali.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Nile Perch with Lime
recipes.summary: Firm white fillets seared golden with a lime finish.
steps: Season the fillets and dust lightly with flour.
Pan-fry in hot butter 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
Squeeze over the lime and scatter coriander.

recipes.title: Tomato and Onion Fish Stew
recipes.summary: Chunks of fish poached in a simple tomato gravy.
steps: Fry the onions until soft, add garlic and curry powder.
Add the tomatoes and cook to a sauce.
Add the fish and half a cup of water, cover and simmer 12 minutes.
Finish with coriander.

recipes.title: Beef Mince and Onion Stew
recipes.summary: A rich weeknight stew of minced beef, onions and tomatoes.
steps: Fry the mince until browned and crumbly.
Add onion and garlic; cook until soft, then stir in curry powder.
Add tomatoes, carrot and a cup of water.
Simmer 20 minutes until thick; serve with rice, ugali or chapati.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.summary: A slow-simmered meat sauce over spaghetti.
ingredients: 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stick, 3 garlic cloves
steps: Brown the mince; add the finely chopped vegetables and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, wine, tomatoes and oregano.
Simmer 45 minutes, adding water if it dries.
Cook the spaghetti, toss with the sauce and top with cheese.

recipes.title: Meat Lasagne
recipes.summary: Layers of pasta, meat sauce and creamy white sauce baked golden.
ingredients: 50 g butter, 50 g flour, 600 ml milk, nutmeg, salt
steps: Make the white sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour and add milk gradually until thick.
Layer sauce, sheets, white sauce and cheese in a dish, finishing with white sauce and cheese.
Bake at 180 C for 40 minutes until bubbling and golden; rest 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Juicy Beef Burgers
recipes.summary: Thick patties with the right amount of fat for a juicy bite.
steps: Divide the mince into four and shape lightly, pressing a dimple in the centre.
Season the outside just before cooking.
Grill or pan-fry 4 minutes per side, adding cheese for the last minute.
Toast the buns in butter and build the burgers.
recipes.tips: Do not overwork the mince.

recipes.title: Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Soft meatballs simmered in a garlicky tomato sauce.
ingredients: 1 egg, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 2 garlic cloves, salt, pepper, parsley
1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 can tomatoes or 5 fresh, 1 tsp oregano, oil
steps: Mix the meatball ingredients and roll into walnut-sized balls.
Brown them in oil and set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic, add tomatoes and oregano.
Return the meatballs and simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta Skewers
recipes.summary: Spiced minced lamb moulded on skewers and grilled.
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika
steps: Mix everything well, squeeze out onion juice first.
Mould around skewers and chill 20 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat 8-10 minutes, turning.
Serve with yoghurt, salad and flatbread.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.summary: Savoury lamb or beef mince under a golden mash topping.
steps: Brown the mince with onion and carrots; stir in paste and flour.
Add stock and Worcestershire and simmer 15 minutes; add peas.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk.
Spoon the mince in a dish, top with mash, ruffle with a fork and bake at 200 C for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausages with Onion Gravy
recipes.summary: Browned sausages in a sweet onion gravy over mash.
steps: Brown the sausages gently in a pan and set aside.
Cook the onions slowly in the same pan for 15 minutes until golden.
Stir in flour, stock and mustard and simmer until thick.
Return the sausages and warm through; serve with mash.

recipes.title: Matumbo (Tripe Stew)
recipes.summary: Beef tripe slowly simmered until tender then cooked with onion and tomato.
steps: Wash the tripe with salt and lemon and cut into strips.
Boil with salt for 1.5-2 hours until tender.
Fry onions, garlic and ginger; add turmeric and tomatoes.
Add the tripe and some stock; simmer 15 minutes and finish with coriander. Serve with ugali.
recipes.tips: Clean thoroughly; tripe needs long, steady cooking.

recipes.title: Liver and Onions (Maini)
recipes.summary: Quickly fried liver with soft onions, best not overcooked.
ingredients: 500 g beef or goat liver, sliced
steps: Soak the liver in milk for 20 minutes if you like a milder taste, then dry.
Cook onions in oil until soft and golden; set aside.
Sear the liver 1-2 minutes per side in a hot pan.
Add the onions back, season and add lemon juice. Do not overcook.
recipes.tips: Liver turns tough fast, so keep the cooking short.

recipes.title: Mukimo with Beef Stew
recipes.summary: A Kikuyu comfort dish of mashed potatoes, greens and maize served with a beef stew.
ingredients: 1 kg potatoes, 2 cups cooked maize or green peas, 2 cups pumpkin leaves or spinach, salt
500 g beef, 2 onions, 3 tomatoes, 2 garlic cloves, oil, salt
steps: Cook the beef stew following the Kenyan Beef Stew method.
Boil the potatoes until soft; steam the greens separately.
Mash the potatoes with the maize and greens until combined and green.
Serve a mound of mukimo with the stew.

recipes.title: Mutura (Kenyan Sausage)
recipes.summary: A street-food sausage of seasoned meat and tripe, usually bought from a trusted maker.
ingredients: Cleaned goat or beef intestine casing
steps: Season and mix the meat, offal, onion and herbs.
Stuff the cleaned casing carefully and tie in lengths.
Boil gently for 20 minutes, then grill or fry until browned.
Slice and serve with kachumbari.
recipes.tips: Casings and offal need excellent hygiene. Buy from a source you trust.

recipes.title: Bone Broth (Supu ya Mifupa)
recipes.summary: A slow-simmered beef bone broth for sipping or as a base for stews.
steps: Roast the bones at 200 C for 30 minutes for deeper flavour.
Put bones, vinegar and vegetables in a pot with water; bring to the boil and skim.
Simmer gently 6-8 hours, topping up water.
Strain, season and chill; lift off the fat.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Nyama Choma
recipes.summary: Kenya's favourite: beef ribs or steaks grilled slowly over charcoal with just salt.
ingredients: 2 kg beef ribs, rump or short ribs
steps: Rub the meat lightly with oil and salt and bring to room temperature.
Light the charcoal and wait for white ash and steady heat.
Grill on moderate heat, turning every few minutes, 45-60 minutes until browned and tender.
Chop on a board, sprinkle with salt and serve with kachumbari.
recipes.tips: Moderate, steady heat gives tender nyama choma; high heat burns the outside.

recipes.title: Mbuzi Choma (Roast Goat)
recipes.summary: Goat ribs and legs slow-roasted over coals until tender.
ingredients: 2 kg goat meat on the bone
steps: Pre-boil goat for 20-30 minutes in lightly salted water if the meat is mature, then dry.
Rub with oil and salt.
Roast slowly over coals, 60-75 minutes, turning often.
Chop and serve with kachumbari and ugali.

recipes.title: Kuku Choma (Grilled Chicken)
recipes.summary: Marinated chicken grilled over coals until smoky and juicy.
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, split or in pieces
steps: Marinate the chicken in garlic, ginger, lemon, paprika, oil and salt for 1 hour.
Grill on medium heat, 20-25 minutes per side, until juices run clear.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with kachumbari and chips.

recipes.title: Pork Nyama Choma
recipes.summary: Slowly grilled pork ribs and belly, crisped at the edges.
steps: Season the pork with salt and pepper.
Grill over moderate coals for 50-60 minutes, turning often until cooked through and crisp.
Chop and serve.
recipes.tips: Pork must be cooked through.

recipes.title: Mishkaki (Beef Skewers)
recipes.summary: Marinated beef cubes on skewers, a coastal street-food classic.
ingredients: 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder
steps: Mix the marinade and coat the beef; refrigerate 2 hours or longer.
Thread on skewers.
Grill on a hot fire 8-10 minutes, turning and brushing with oil.

recipes.title: Beer-Can Grilled Chicken
recipes.summary: Upright chicken roasted over a can of beer or stock for juicy meat.
ingredients: 1 can beer (or half full of stock)
2 tbsp spice rub (paprika, salt, garlic powder, pepper)
steps: Rub the chicken with oil and spice rub.
Seat it on the half-full can so it stands upright.
Grill over indirect medium heat with the lid closed for 70-80 minutes until 74 C inside.
Rest 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Grilled T-Bone Steak
recipes.summary: A butcher's favourite combining strip and fillet in one cut.
steps: Season and bring to room temperature.
Sear on a very hot grill 4 minutes per side, then finish on lower heat to medium-rare.
Rest 5 minutes with a knob of butter.

recipes.title: Kachumbari
recipes.summary: The fresh tomato and onion salad that goes with every nyama choma.
steps: Soak the sliced onion in cold salted water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Combine with tomatoes, chilli, coriander, lemon juice and salt.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Ugali
recipes.summary: Firm maize meal staple; the right partner for grilled meat and stews.
steps: Bring the water to the boil with salt.
Slowly add half the flour, stirring to avoid lumps.
Add the remaining flour and keep pressing and turning with a wooden spoon for 8-10 minutes until firm.
Shape in a bowl and serve hot.
recipes.tips: Keep stirring; ugali needs strong arms.

recipes.title: Pili Pili Hot Sauce
recipes.summary: A bright, fiery dipping sauce for grilled meat.
steps: Roast the chillies, tomatoes and garlic until lightly charred.
Blend with lemon, oil and salt.
Cool and keep in the fridge up to a week.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma at Home
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken thigh grilled and wrapped with garlic sauce and pickles.
ingredients: 1 tbsp shawarma spice (cumin, paprika, coriander, turmeric)
Pita or flatbread, cabbage, tomato, pickles
1/2 cup yoghurt, 1 garlic clove, lemon, salt
steps: Marinate the chicken in yoghurt, lemon, spice and garlic for 2 hours.
Sear or grill 5-6 minutes per side, then slice thinly.
Warm the bread, spread with garlic sauce, add chicken, cabbage, tomato and pickles and roll tightly.

recipes.title: Smokie Pasua
recipes.summary: A smokie split and stuffed with kachumbari, the iconic Nairobi snack.
steps: Grill or pan-fry the smokies until browned.
Split lengthwise (pasua) without cutting through.
Stuff with kachumbari and drizzle sauce.

recipes.title: Kenyan Beef Samosas
recipes.summary: Crisp triangles filled with spiced beef mince and onion.
steps: Cook the mince with onion, garlic and spices until dry; cool completely and add coriander.
Fold the pastry into cones, fill and seal with flour paste.
Fry in medium-hot oil 3-4 minutes until golden.
Drain and serve with chilli sauce.
recipes.tips: Cool the filling fully so the pastry stays crisp.

recipes.title: Chapati Beef Roll
recipes.summary: Soft chapati wrapped around spiced beef, kachumbari and a drizzle of sauce.
steps: Fry the beef with onion, tomato and curry powder until dry and well seasoned.
Warm the chapatis.
Add beef, kachumbari and sauce and roll tightly.

recipes.title: Fish and Chips
recipes.summary: Crisp beer-battered fish with golden chips.
ingredients: 1 cup flour, 1/2 cup cold water or beer, 1 tsp baking powder, salt
steps: Soak the cut potatoes in cold water, dry well and fry in two stages (150 C then 190 C) until golden.
Mix the batter, dip the fillets and fry at 180 C for 5-6 minutes until crisp.
Drain, salt and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Doner-Style Beef Plate
recipes.summary: Thin marinated beef cooked hot and served with rice or flatbread and sauces.
ingredients: 2 tbsp yoghurt, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 2 garlic cloves
steps: Marinate the beef in yoghurt, paste, spices and garlic for 2 hours.
Sear in a very hot pan in batches until browned at the edges.
Serve on flatbread with salad and sauces.

recipes.title: How to Choose Fresh Meat: A Butcher's Checklist
recipes.summary: What to look for in colour, smell and texture before you buy beef, goat, pork or chicken.
recipes.body:
Good cooking starts at the counter. Use this quick checklist whenever you buy meat.

## Beef
- Colour: bright cherry red on the surface. A slightly darker colour inside a vacuum pack is normal.
- Fat: creamy white, not yellow or greasy.
- Feel: firm and moist, not sticky or slimy.
- Smell: clean and fresh. Sour or sharp smells mean it is old.

## Goat and lamb
- Light pink to deep red meat with firm, white fat.
- Younger animals are milder and more tender; older ones are stronger and need slower cooking.

## Pork
- Pale pink flesh with white fat. Avoid grey or watery meat.

## Chicken
- Skin should look moist and plump with no bruising. The smell should be neutral.
- Always keep raw chicken separate from other food.

## Fish
- Bright, clear eyes, red gills and a fresh sea or lake smell. Flesh should spring back when pressed.

## Ask your butcher
Tell us how you plan to cook it. We will cut it for you: thin for stir-fry, thick for steaks, small cubes for stew, or bone-in for soup.

recipes.title: Know Your Beef Cuts: Which Cut for Which Dish
recipes.summary: A simple map of popular beef cuts and the cooking method that suits each.
recipes.body:
Beef cuts fall into two groups: tender cuts that need quick, hot cooking and tougher cuts that need slow, moist cooking.

## Quick, hot cooking (grill or pan)
- Fillet: the most tender, very lean. Pan-sear or grill briefly.
- Ribeye: rich marbling, great on a grill.
- Sirloin and rump: flavourful steaks, good for nyama choma and stir-fry.
- T-bone: strip and fillet in one cut.

## Slow cooking (stew, braise, roast)
- Brisket: pot roast or smoking.
- Chuck and shin: stews, curries and soups.
- Oxtail: slow-braised until sticky and rich.
- Short ribs and ribs: slow grill or braise.

## Minced beef
Choose a mince with around 15-20 percent fat for burgers and meatballs; leaner mince suits stews and sauces.

## Rule of thumb
More connective tissue means more time and liquid. Less means more heat and less time.

recipes.title: Nyama Choma Like a Pro: Fire, Salt and Patience
recipes.summary: How to get tender, smoky, well-seasoned grilled meat every time.
recipes.body:
Great nyama choma is simple, but the details matter.

## 1. Pick the right meat
Goat and beef ribs, rump, and pork belly all work. Bone-in meat stays juicier.

## 2. Bring it to room temperature
Take the meat out of the fridge 30 minutes before grilling so it cooks evenly.

## 3. Manage your fire
- Wait until the coals are covered in white ash.
- Aim for steady medium heat. Flames burn the outside and leave the inside raw.
- Keep a cooler spot for meat that is browning too quickly.

## 4. Season simply
Coarse salt is enough. Add lemon, garlic or pepper if you like.

## 5. Turn often, rest at the end
Turn every few minutes. Rest for 5 minutes before chopping so the juices settle.

## 6. Serve right
Kachumbari, ugali and a hot pili pili sauce complete the plate.

recipes.title: Marinades 101: Flavour, Tenderness and Timing
recipes.summary: How acid, oil, salt and spice work, and how long to marinate each meat.
recipes.body:
A marinade has four jobs: season, tenderise slightly, add moisture and add flavour.

## The basic formula
- Oil: carries flavour and prevents sticking.
- Acid: lemon, vinegar, yoghurt or tomato.
- Salt: seasons deeply. Soy sauce counts.
- Aromatics: garlic, ginger, herbs, spices.

## How long?
- Fish and seafood: 15-30 minutes. Acid cooks it fast.
- Chicken: 1-4 hours (overnight in yoghurt is fine).
- Pork: 2-12 hours.
- Beef steaks: 30 minutes to 4 hours.
- Goat and lamb: 2-12 hours.

## Tips
- Pat the meat dry before it hits the grill so it browns instead of steams.
- Never reuse raw marinade as a sauce unless you boil it first.
- Too much acid for too long makes meat mushy.

recipes.title: Meat Safety: Temperatures, Storage and Thawing
recipes.summary: Keep your family safe with these simple rules for cooking and storing meat.
recipes.body:
## Safe internal temperatures
- Chicken and turkey: 74 C
- Minced meat and sausages: 71 C
- Pork: 63 C then rest 3 minutes
- Beef, lamb and goat steaks: from 63 C (medium) upwards
- Fish: 63 C or until opaque and flaking

## Storage
- Fridge: below 4 C. Use fresh mince within 1-2 days, steaks and chops within 3 days.
- Freezer: freeze in meal-sized portions. Label with the date.
- Keep raw meat on the bottom shelf in a covered container.

## Thawing
- Best: overnight in the fridge.
- Faster: sealed bag in cold water, changing the water every 30 minutes.
- Never thaw on the counter.

## Cross-contamination
Use separate boards and knives for raw meat, wash hands after handling it, and never put cooked meat on a plate that held raw meat.

recipes.title: How to Cook Goat So It Is Tender
recipes.summary: Goat is lean and flavourful. These steps keep it soft and juicy.
recipes.body:
Goat has less fat than beef or lamb, so it needs patience.

## Choose the cut
- Leg: roast slowly or cut into stew pieces.
- Ribs and chops: grill gently or boil first then grill.
- Shoulder and neck: great for stews and soup.

## Cook it slowly
- Simmer in water or stock for 1-2 hours before finishing on the grill.
- Cover roasts tightly with foil and cook at 150-160 C.

## Add fat and flavour
- Fry in oil with onion, garlic and ginger.
- Use tomatoes, yoghurt or coconut milk to keep the sauce rich.

## Do not rush
Goat tastes best when it is cooked until the meat pulls easily from the bone.

recipes.title: Stock Your Freezer: Portioning Meat Like a Pro
recipes.summary: Save money and time by buying in bulk and freezing in smart portions.
recipes.body:
Buying in bulk and freezing saves money, but only if you do it right.

## Portion first
Split meat into the sizes you cook: 500 g for a family stew, 1 kg for a roast, single steaks or chicken pieces.

## Wrap well
- Squeeze out the air and seal tight in freezer bags or vacuum packs.
- Flatten bags so they freeze and thaw faster.
- Label with the cut and date.

## How long?
- Mince and sausages: 3 months
- Steaks, chops and chicken pieces: 6 months
- Whole roasts and big cuts: up to 9-12 months

## Thaw safely
Move to the fridge the night before, and cook within a day.

## Ask us
Our butchers can cut and pack to the portion sizes you need.

recipes.title: Kenyan Meat Cooking Words: A Short Glossary
recipes.summary: Nyama, mchuzi, kachumbari and more: words you will see on our menu and recipes.
recipes.body:
## Common words
- Nyama: meat.
- Nyama choma: grilled meat, usually over charcoal.
- Mchuzi: stew or gravy.
- Wet-fry: meat fried and finished in a sauce.
- Supu: soup or broth.
- Mbuzi: goat.  Ng'ombe: beef.  Kuku: chicken.  Nguruwe: pork.  Samaki: fish.
- Matumbo: tripe.  Maini: liver.
- Mutura: seasoned sausage.
- Kachumbari: tomato and onion salad.
- Ugali: firm maize meal.
- Pilau: spiced rice cooked in stock.
- Mishkaki: marinated skewered meat.
- Pili pili: hot chilli.
